wiki.title: Pilar Schiavo
wiki.extract: Pilar Schiavo (born January 22, 1975) is a member of the California State Assembly, representing the state's 40th District as a member of the Democratic Party since 2022. The area represents parts of northwest San Fernando Valley, Santa Clarita Valley and Valencia. Prior to serving in the Assembly, Schiavo was a small business owner and Nurse Advocate.
